source.name: Open Food Facts food ingredients taxonomy

selection.purpose: Strict common-material product candidates for review and merge with the existing catalogue.
selection.canonicalCounting: One source-derived semantic record per common material. Open Food Facts aliases are retained for search and never counted as separate materials.
selection.scope: The broader strict export remains available for future expansion; this product file deliberately keeps common, independently usable culinary/bar materials and a small set of common prepared forms.
exclusions: Rare specialty and botanical entries, industrial derivatives, percentage/standard-content variants, named packaged products, and source records with inexact mixtures.
Composite and processing-heavy variants are held in the broader strict export rather than counted here.
No brands, bottles, meat, fish, shellfish, roe, additives, vitamins, minerals, flavorings or invented language variants are counted.
